sv.title: Galet projekt håller Queen-nivå
sv.summary: Dani Massaad ger sig på ett helt galet debutprojekt – och lyckas ro det iland. Det skriver Di Weekends musikrecensent Jan Gradvall, som också har sett en dokumentär om svenska hårdrockspionjärer.

en.title: Crazy project holds Queen-level standard
en.summary: Dani Massaad takes on a completely crazy debut project – and manages to bring it home. This is written by Di Weekend's music critic Jan Gradvall, who has also watched a documentary about Swedish hard rock pioneers.
